authority: Production ui/ is authoritative; the static prototype is the approval reference and does not replace ui/.

intent.surface: Calm fleet workbench and single home canvas.
intent.operator_job: See current work, fleet state, project context, and live records before asking the top manager what happens next.
intent.routing: Every AI request goes to the top manager; direct run verbs act on a selected run.
deferred: chat history as a separate surface

body.family: Inter, Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif

registry.authored: Discovered from /__widgets, labeled authored, and rendered through SandboxWidget.

responsive.mobile_composer: Normal-flow workspace child outside the bounded one-column canvas, preserving a separate composer region.

clock.toggle: Top-bar clock button and sidebar widget toggle mutate the mounted layout and persist it.

interaction.mounting: Widget chips toggle mounted ids with aria-pressed and normalize the selected span.

movement.drop: Move dragged widget before the drop target rather than swap.
movement.keyboard: Arrow keys move one mounted position and retain grip focus.

resize.pointer: Pointer capture previews and commits a final grid-snapped span.
resize.keyboard: Arrow keys nudge one column or row.
resize.preview: Only the final span is persisted.

interaction.selection_anchor: Focus, mouse enter, or pointer down on a widget stamps its title as composer context.
interaction.anchor_reset: The about chip resets context to canvas.

request.pending: Disable textarea and send control while asking.
request.success: Reset form and show accepted run id prefix.

interaction.reduced_motion: Disable smooth scrolling and clamp transitions and animations to .01ms with one animation iteration.

persistence.load: Normalize version, mounted ids, duplicate ids, and missing spans before rendering; invalid or stale data falls back to default layout.
persistence.save: Serialize layout edits through a promise queue so an older response cannot win a later edit.
persistence.runtime_boundary: The runtime stores the blob but never parses frontend layout.

bridge_security.host: The host owns the operator token and file-system boundary; widgets receive only a bridge.
bridge_security.anchor_integrity: Host stamps widget id, title, and optional cell subject; a widget cannot claim another widget's context.
bridge_security.cell_rule: A widget displays a cell and never addresses an individual cell.

widget_distinctions.runs: Lifecycle records and direct run controls.
widget_distinctions.windows: Provider accounts and provider-stated quota windows.

fleet_semantics.routing: Top manager is the sole AI request destination.
fleet_semantics.worker_relationship: Delegated workers are indented under the manager that handed them the job.
fleet_semantics.conversation_voice: Operator and manager messages use edge color and indentation instead of bubbles.
fleet_semantics.quota_truth: Provider meters show provider-stated values; Farseer's own spend is a lower bound and is not presented as provider usage.

scope_limits: Production ui/ is authoritative and remains the shipped client.
The static prototype is an approval reference and does not replace production ui/.
Full chat composition and chat history as a separate surface are deferred.
The home remains one canvas with widgets rather than a second layout, mode switch, runtime, or plugin ABI.
This design record does not claim a new backend, runner implementation, or runtime replacement.
